title: ConstraintViolationBench: Extending Outcome-Driven Constraint Benchmarks to Training Evaluation

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Comparing constraint adherence across training methods (RLHF, SFT, DPO) provides useful practical guidance. However, the impact depends on the original benchmark being representative, and the connection to novel safety insights is moderate.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires fine-tuning under three different training regimes (RLHF, SFT, DPO) and evaluating each. Setting up PPO-based RLHF is significantly beyond beginner level. Even with libraries, the multi-regime comparison is complex.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three separate training runs (RLHF, SFT, DPO) plus evaluation on the constraint benchmark. Each training run alone is time-consuming. Far too broad for 30 hours at beginner level.
